description: The configuration behind every LoCoMo figure this repository publishes. reproduce.py reads this file and nothing else, so the config you are reading is the config that runs.

engine.note: main at bc3dfdf plus the onnxruntime ~=1.29.0 pin (PR #16). The engine and harness trees are identical to main; only pyproject.toml and CHANGELOG.md differ. The pull-request ref keeps this commit fetchable after the branch is merged or deleted.

dataset.name: LoCoMo (locomo10.json)
dataset.question_id_scheme: {sample_id}:q{j}, j the 0-based index into that conversation's qa list

models.route_note: At this engine commit the harness reaches the models through the Claude Code CLI. An OpenAI-compatible route for the same model ids is in review as engraphy PR #8; once it lands, the engine pin moves to a commit carrying it and reproduce.py gains --route openai.

thresholds_resolved.note: Read back at runtime from the pinned engine on the onnx-fp32 profile. Recorded here so a change in any of them is a visible diff to this file.
